phase: Phase F2b - F2 with station-bias and K_SRP priors
written: 2026-10-24, before any F2b number was computed
motivation: F2 (studies/phase17/reports/phase_f2_lro_od.md): single-pass stations let their free biases absorb whole passes and K_SRP acted as an empirical force (1.78 m^2/kg); the problem had several minima
change_from_F2: identical to F2 (dynamics, measurement model, starts, termination, A1 sensitivities) except: (1) station-bias priors with mean = F1's M_FULL per-station mean residual over its passes on 2009-260 (PAD 103: 489.161 m, 105: 476.891 m, 126: 474.509 m) and sigma 3 m; (2) K_SRP prior 0.010 +- 0.005 m^2/kg; (3) N = 100 only (both starts)
independence_caveat: the bias prior means were measured against the LOLA orbit (F1), so the F2b comparison with LOLA is not independent at the level of the three constant station delays; the orbit itself is not seeded (same +-1 km / 1 m/s starts)

gates.G2_start_independence: the two solutions agree to <= 1 m in position over the arc and <= 0.1 m in each bias (relaxed from F2's 1 cm / 1 mm: with priors the problem is regularised but not noise-free)

reported_not_gated: position difference to the LOLA SPK (R/A/C RMS and max, total), K_SRP estimate, bias estimates vs priors
